abstract: This paper tests if bureaucratic leadership impacts the quality of service provision of a difficult-to-monitor task: learning in public schools. Using the empirical case of rural India, it exploits an administrative setup with two types of bureaucrats for the same spatial unit, the district, that either have more authority or more ability to engage in time-intensive persuasion. Utilizing blocked randomization inference and bias-corrected variance decomposition on bureaucratic postings linked to independent learning data from household surveys across 10 years, it shows that only those bureaucrats with less authority but more ability to engage in persuasion impact learning. Drawing on novel interview data, it illustrates how bureaucratic leaders can increase effort levels of subordinates through persuasion to overcome collective action problems rather than relying on orders and monitoring as principal-agent frameworks would suggest. The findings illustrate that for difficult-to-monitor tasks managerial intensity and persistence trump formal authority.
title: Breaking out of low-effort traps: bureaucratic leadership by persuasion

abstract: Bulgaria has successfully liberalised its economy and integrated into global value chains, creating jobs and raising incomes. However, businesses face long-standing challenges of low productivity. Catching up has been steady but a productivity gap with the more advanced economies remains. This paper calculates labour productivity and estimates total factor productivity based on Bulgarian micro data for 2018-23 collected by the National Statistical Institute of Bulgaria and Orbis for international comparison. Bulgarian firms in some manufacturing industries such as garments or manufacturing of machinery and equipment are less productive than other countries in the greater region, while they are more productive in some services, such as computer programming. As expected, larger and foreign firms, exporters and those located in the region around Sofia are more productive. The paper estimates markups to assess competitive pressures, and such estimates are very high in a few manufacturing industries, such as pharmaceuticals and transport equipment, and a large number of service industries such as utilities, trade of vehicles, accommodation and commerce, raising concerns about the level of competition in those markets.
authors: Margit Molnar & Serdar Sengul & Christian Gréus
title: Productivity and markup estimates for Bulgaria based on firm-level data

abstract: Overemployment – working more hours than desired – affects nearly one-third of European workers, yet its consequences remain understudied. Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP, 1984-2019, N = 43,570) and individual fixed-effects models with leads and lags, we examine whether overemployment is associated with a deterioration in wellbeing and health, and whether potential adverse impacts persist as long as the overemployment state continues or whether people get used to working long hours. We find that overemployment is associated with a substantial decline in mental health, with impacts that intensify rather than attenuate over time. Specifically, the SF-12 mental health summary scale declines by 0.44 points in the first year of overemployment, deepening to between 0.80 and 1.13 points (8–11% of a standard deviation) thereafter. We obtain similar results for work, leisure time, health, and overall life satisfaction. Meanwhile, the association between overemployment and physical health is smaller and less consistent. Our findings suggest that overemployment may lead to an increased risk of persistent symptoms of poor mental health and low wellbeing, with implications for working time regulations and workplace wellbeing and health policies.
title: Do people get used to working long hours?

abstract: This paper develops a micro-based, bottom-up approach to quantify the macroeconomic costs of climate change. It combines empirically estimated local climate damages with a global spatial general equilibrium model: the Climate and Adaptation Spatial General Equilibrium Model (OECD-CASGEM). The model links location-specific climate hazards to economy-wide outcomes through trade, migration, production networks, and factor adjustments, capturing the role of spatial and economic adjustments as adaptation shaping aggregate and regional losses. Estimated global GDP per capita losses amount to 3% by 2050 and 6.3% by 2100 under a current-policy scenario (SSP2-4.5) and to 6% and 18%, respectively, under a high-emission scenario (SSP5-8.5), with large associated uncertainty. Losses are highly uneven across regions and are larger in lower-latitude countries and those historically more exposed to climate hazards. Counterfactual simulations show that trade linkages, migration and production networks can dampen or amplify aggregate losses depending on countries’ exposure, economic structure and position in global networks. Spatial mechanisms, in particular, reduce cross-regional dispersion in impacts, effectively operating as a form of implicit loss-sharing across locations.
authors: Diogo Baptista & Hélia Costa & Filiz Unsal
title: The climate and adaptation spatial general equilibrium model (OECD-CASGEM): The macroeconomic cost of climate change

abstract: 金融科技是提升金融服务实体经济质效、支持企业“出海”的重要支撑。本文利用大语言模型识别中国商业银行金融科技专利,依托银行和企业的关系网络构造2013-2023年我国上市公司面临的银行金融科技创新水平,结合FactSet Revere全球供应链数据,考察银行金融科技创新对企业跨国供应链拓展的影响。研究发现,银行金融科技创新显著增加企业国际客户合同数量,促进国际客户网络拓展,但对国际供应商网络的作用相对有限,其主要推动了企业跨国供应链向下游延伸,且这种影响在非国有、中小规模、无通道业务,以及地区金融监管环境相对严格的企业中更为明显。银行金融科技创新通过信息识别、个性化信贷配置及风险承担机制,促进企业开展国际客户合作。本文从跨国供应链视角丰富了金融科技赋能实体经济和支持企业“出海”的经验证据。

abstract: “边缘企业”能否在既定出口市场持续扩张,是检验跨境电商政策赋能效应的重要维度。本文将跨境电商政策冲击引入多产品异质性企业框架,并基于2000-2015年中国海关数据库与上市公司数据的匹配样本,以2012年跨境电商政策推进为准自然实验,构建企业-出口目的地-年份层面的双重差分模型,考察跨境电商政策对企业在既定目的地市场出口突围的影响。研究发现,跨境电商显著促进了企业出口产品范围扩张和出口收入增长,且对初始出口能力相对较弱的“边缘企业”作用更强。机制检验表明,跨境电商通过缓解外部交易摩擦、提升目的地市场渗透效率和增强产品转换能力,从而缓解企业进入既定目的地市场后的扩张约束。此外,跨境电商赋能效应受国内供给侧调整能力、行业竞争结构以及海外本土化服务的共同制约。本文为完善数字贸易政策、稳定外贸主体及优化出口结构提供了经验证据。

abstract: 充分释放超大规模市场潜力,是推动经济高质量发展的重要议题。本文采用多时点双重差分模型,系统考察市场准入负面清单制度对居民消费的提振效应。研究发现：第一,该制度对居民家庭消费水平具有显著的提升作用。第二,在供给结构优化路径上,从企业层面看,政策实施后市场竞争加剧,同时企业创新投入有所增加;从行业层面看,企业进入主要集中在服务业,尤其是直接面向居民日常消费的生活性服务业;从家庭层面看,居民消费意愿增强,家庭储蓄率下降。在收入提振路径上,政策带动企业生产扩张和用工需求增加,居民工资性收入提升,消费能力随之增强。第三,异质性分析发现,市场准入负面清单制度的消费提振效应在制度环境较差、服务业发展滞后的地区更为显著。第四,政府干预规模过大会削弱政策效果,而增加一般公共服务支出能有效强化政策效果。本文为深化市场准入负面清单制度改革以促进消费扩容升级、强化供需双侧协同以及优化政府治理和财政支出结构提供了一定的经验参考。

abstract: 破除区域间行政分割是推动企业跨地区经营、实现区域市场整合的关键举措。本文基于全国税收调查与中国工商注册企业数据构建的“总部-分支”面板数据,使用多时点双重差分模型,考察以撤县设区为代表的行政区划调整对企业跨地区经营的影响。研究发现,撤县设区显著增加了总部位于被撤县的企业在本市辖区设立分支机构的数量,促进了商品与服务在市域内部跨地区流动。机制检验表明,该效应主要通过削弱区县间行政分割,进而降低制度性准入壁垒、增强市场可达性和优化金融资源配置实现。进一步研究发现,撤县设区对企业跨地区经营的促进作用主要表现为从外围到中心的单向“虹吸效应”,反向的“扩散效应”并不明显。本文为优化空间治理结构、破除区域间行政分割并推进全国统一大市场建设提供了微观证据。

abstract: 近年来,ESG数据已成为学术研究的重要基础设施,但机构间的评级分歧降低了分析结论的可靠性与可比性。本文基于国内主流ESG评级机构的数据,通过对代表性研究主题的复现,发现研究结论往往依赖特定数据,来自不同数据供应商的ESG评级存在系统性差异,导致基于不同数据来源的研究结论明显不同。在详细拆解评级数据底层逻辑的基础上,本文用偏好依附理论解释ESG评级的动态形成机制,揭示了ESG数据中的“马太效应”,提出基于行业排名的非线性误差校正方法,并进一步验证了该方法在提升数据相关性、增强分析结论稳健性方面的效果。本文为提高中国ESG评级数据的一致性和ESG研究的稳健性提供了具体的操作指引。

abstract: 文化建设对于增强民众主观福祉有重要意义。本文基于网络外部性视角,利用中国家庭追踪调查与地级市博物馆数据,考察博物馆普惠化对居民幸福感的影响。研究发现,居民幸福感随博物馆供给扩大呈局部非连续跃增。当场馆数量较少时,布局较为分散,系统性福祉效应尚需网络支撑。随着供给持续扩大,当博物馆数量达到20家、服务半径达到居民可便捷抵达的合理区间时,居民幸福感显著提升。本文以“地级市博物馆数量首次达到20家”构造准自然实验,利用多期双重差分模型分析表明,博物馆普惠化使居民幸福感提升0.078个单位,主要通过增强公平感知、积累社会资本与改善心理健康三条路径实现。本文为优化文化基础设施布局、推动精神共富提供了经验依据。

abstract: 本文以生成式人工智能为研究对象,基于招聘平台岗位大数据,采用双重差分方法考察其对中国劳动力市场的影响。研究发现,生成式人工智能应用显著降低了岗位平均薪资。机制研究表明,现阶段其岗位替代效应大于生产率提升效应,是构成薪资下行的主要渠道。异质性分析发现,对软技能要求不高、认知型的岗位薪资下降更为明显;相比之下,依赖现场服务与人际交互的岗位薪资则有所上升。生成式人工智能在替代部分岗位的同时,亦带动了云网智能运维员、生成式人工智能系统应用员等新兴职业的岗位需求增长,体现出技术变革的创造性破坏特征。本文建议,应强化就业动态监测与完善多层次社会保障体系,积极培育新质生产力所需的职业类型,促进劳动力市场平稳转型。

abstract: Stochastic debt sustainability analysis (SDSA) is a key tool for assessing risks in modern fiscal policymaking. Yet, designing and calibrating these models poses significant challenges. Using a panel of up to 24 OECD countries with data spanning from 1980, this paper argues that pooling data across countries provides a more representative reflection of fiscal risks, effectively extends sample periods, and a trend-cycle approach better accounts for structural changes. The choice of calibration method is policy relevant as it substantially alters the required primary balance adjustments to stabilise the debt ratio implied by the models. Given that real-time macroeconomic risks are skewed to the downside during economic upswings, the paper proposes a state-contingent (SC-SDSA) approach conditioned on contemporaneous output gap estimates. This suggests that risks are greater during economic booms than conventional approaches and that larger structural primary balances are required than in normal times to ensure adequate fiscal buffers.
authors: Sebastian Barnes & Eddie Casey & Fred Hanmer
title: Assessing risks to fiscal policy: Calibrating stochastic debt sustainability analysis models
title_zh: 评估财政政策风险：校准随机债务可持续性分析模型

abstract: This paper provides new evidence on the prevalence and potential effects of non-compete and related clauses in Canada using OECD surveys of workers and firms. It finds that these clauses are widespread, increasingly used, and often applied beyond roles where they are most justified. Many appear overly broad and legally weak, yet a substantial share of workers report having been prevented from changing jobs or starting a business. Their impact is reinforced by behavioural factors, including reputational and ethical concerns. The findings also bring into closer focus the use of (firm-to-firm) no-poaching and wage fixing agreements that restrict labour market competition and, thus, raise broader concerns for the Canadian Competition Bureau.
authors: Dan Andrews & Andrea Garnero & Sara Holttinen
title: Non-compete and related clauses in Canada
title_zh: 加拿大竞业禁止及相关条款

abstract: We document that China’s 2018 domestic regulations, which suppressed the future growth potential of its game app market, unintentionally triggered an immediate and significant export expansion in this sector. This expansion was largely accounted for by apps already established in foreign markets, and was significantly stronger among high-quality firms. To rationalize these patterns, we develop and calibrate a dynamic model featuring customer accumulation under capacity constraints. In response to the regulatory shocks, firms proactively reallocate resources toward foreign markets, with higher-quality firms exhibiting a stronger reallocation response. This proactive behavior further amplifies the welfare losses borne by domestic consumers.

abstract_zh: 本文揭示了中国2018年实施的国内监管政策，在抑制其游戏应用市场未来增长潜力的同时，意外地引发了该行业即时且显著的出口扩张。这一扩张主要源于已在海外市场立足的应用产品，且在高品质企业中表现尤为突出。为解释上述现象，我们构建并校准了一个包含产能约束下客户积累特征的动态模型。面对监管冲击，企业主动将资源重新配置至海外市场，其中高品质企业展现出更强的资源再配置响应。这种主动行为进一步加剧了国内消费者承担的福利损失。

abstract: Standard economic rationale suggests that an enhancement of conflict-effort efficiency or sabotage efficiency in contests, benefits the player who is experiencing the improvement. This paper presents a model of sabotage in the context of attacker-defender contest with ‘gun’ and ‘butter’ (as posited by Chowdhury and Topolyan in 2026). We observe a strikingly counter-intuitive outcome – any increase in sabotage efficiency is counter-productive (even for the player experiencing the increase) in terms of equilibrium payoffs. The channel through which the result holds for both players (the attacker and the defender) is the shrinking size of the defender’s ‘butter’ when sabotage efficiency (of either player) increases. The paper also contradicts the findings of Chung in 2024 and Glökler, Pull and Stadler in 2022 who claim that endogenization of the prize alleviates or eliminates sabotage.
abstract_zh: 标准经济理论认为，在竞赛中提升冲突努力效率或破坏效率，将使效率提升的一方获益。本文基于Chowdhury与Topolyan（2026）提出的"枪炮与黄油"攻防竞赛框架，构建了破坏行为模型。我们观察到一种显著反直觉的结果——任何破坏效率的提升（即使对效率提升方而言）在均衡收益层面都会适得其反。该结论对攻防双方均成立的作用机制在于：当任意一方的破坏效率提升时，防御方的"黄油"规模会相应缩减。本文同时反驳了Chung（2024）以及Glökler、Pull与Stadler（2022）的研究结论——后者主张将奖品内生化可缓解或消除破坏行为。
title: The curse of sabotage - efficiency in an attacker - defender framework with gun & butter
title_zh: 破坏的诅咒——枪炮与黄油框架下攻击者-防御者的效率分析

abstract: People with mental illness are frequently discriminated against and stigmatized. We introduce a new measure of perceived depression stigma and examine the causal effect of perceived stigma on help-seeking in a sample of 1844 Americans suffering from depression. We document that a large majority of our participants overestimate the extent of stigma associated with depression. An informational intervention aimed at reducing perceived social stigma decreases the demand for psychotherapy. Merely prompting individuals to think about stigma has a similar effect. A mechanism experiment reveals that our interventions increase both participants’ optimism about future mental health and their readiness to rely on friends and family, thereby reducing the perceived need for therapy. abstract: We investigate how information frictions affect the efficacy of contraception provision programs. We study a Costa-Rican initiative that combined two pillars: free access to long-acting-reversible contraceptives; and a tailored information campaign to raise awareness and correct for baseline misperceptions. Using administrative data and geographic variation in the initiative, we find a 16% decrease in the teen birth rate. We show information complements access: districts exposed to both pillars experience substantially larger reductions than those with contraception access alone. Using surveys on sexual behavior, we show the initiative shifted the information source from personal networks to healthcare professionals, amending misperceptions on sexual health.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨信息摩擦如何影响避孕提供项目的有效性。我们研究了一项哥斯达黎加倡议，该倡议结合了两大支柱：免费获取长效可逆避孕药具；以及一项量身定制的信息宣传活动，旨在提高认识并纠正基线误解。利用行政数据和该倡议的地理差异，我们发现青少年生育率下降了16%。我们表明信息与获取途径相辅相成：同时接触两大支柱的地区，其生育率下降幅度显著大于仅能获取避孕药具的地区。通过关于性行为的调查，我们显示该倡议将信息来源从个人社交网络转向医疗保健专业人员，从而修正了关于性健康的误解。
